title: Overall it’s a great default app
body:
Generally I miss 3 things and the first one is the duration of each task, the second is missing option for completing repetitive task and the third one is not possible option for calling reminders from contact list, it’s possible only from recent calls.

The rest is phenomenal, probably the best app, tags, list, smart list everything.

And what about urgent task? Real game changer!

author: Agiurov

title: Integration with calendar
body:
I wish Reminders had integration with Calendar. 
In order to do a task one needs time to do it, and if it’s not booked on the calendar, I don’t have dedicated time to do it.
This missing feature is the only one that stops me from using the app.
On the positive note I love the board view. Too bad it’s useless without calendar integration.
author: Severel17

title: I mean, it’s not that bad…
body:
In all honesty, for a default reminders app - it’s not bad at all. It has all of the features I can see myself using, it’s well integrated into iOS, and it’s pretty fast to load. Also, since they’ve added early reminders it’s even better!

Maybe, the only thing that could be improved is the organization of reminders, but for me it’s not something I really use.
